description: M4 evaluation suite: the 10 cases committed to in the M3 evaluation plan (report section 8). Run with tests/run_eval.py. Reliability rule: each live case runs 3 times and passes if >= 2/3 runs pass (E6: 5 repeats, >= 4/5).
success_threshold: >= 8/10 cases pass, AND hard gates at 100%: zero invented citations (bad_refs = 0 in every run) and E4 never hallucinates. E10 grounding must be >= 90%.

cases.name: News topic, full pipeline

input.name: New VST plugins
input.why: Music producer; wants to know when notable synths/effects launch or update.

cases.expected_output: recall_coverage first, then search_news; <=3 source calls; 1-4 linked bullets or the exact no-updates line; bad_refs = 0; unchecked = 0

cases.name: Artist topic

input.name: Kendrick Lamar
input.why: Favorite artist - new albums, singles, and features.

cases.expected_output: get_artist_releases called; <=3 source calls (M2: 4-6); release links go to musicbrainz.org; bad_refs = 0

cases.name: Research topic

input.name: Cancer research breakthroughs
input.why: Personal interest in progress on cancer treatment.

cases.expected_output: First source tool is search_research_papers; bullets framed as single studies; no 'cure/miracle/breakthrough cure' wording

cases.name: Nonsense topic (hallucination gate)

input.name: Zorblaxian quantum kazoo
input.why: Test: this topic does not exist.

cases.expected_output: Handoff 1 does not fire; section is exactly '_No notable updates in this window._'; Editor and Checker not called

cases.name: Coverage memory across two runs
cases.input: E1 topic run twice on the same empty memory
cases.expected_output: Run 2 publishes no URL from run 1; memory count = run-1 published count

cases.name: Fact-checker on seeded bullets
cases.input: Source headline 'Baby Keem announces new album Ca$ino, previews collaboration with Kendrick Lamar'. Bullet 0: '...Their new collaboration is the top-selling track of the week.' Bullet 1: faithful paraphrase.
cases.expected_output: Bullet 0 effective verdict overstated/unsupported; bullet 1 supported

cases.name: Sale filtering

input.name: New VST plugins
input.why: Music producer; wants to know when notable synths/effects launch or update - not sales or deals.

cases.expected_output: No published bullet about a discount or deal (sale|% off|deal|discount|Black Friday = 0 hits)

cases.name: Source outage (MusicBrainz unreachable)
cases.input: SIGNALBRIEF_FAULT=musicbrainz.org (every MusicBrainz request fails with HTTP 503); topics: Kendrick Lamar (artist, 30 days) + New VST plugins (news, 7 days)
cases.expected_output: No crash; Scout falls back to news or the section says no updates / could not be researched; other topics unaffected

cases.name: Full 10-topic newsletter
cases.input: The 10 topics in e9_topics below, one run
cases.expected_output: All 10 sections present, no agent errors; total <= 120K tokens; wall time <= 15 min

cases.name: Grounding of every published bullet
cases.input: Every bullet published in E1-E3 and E9, with the headline(s) it cites
cases.expected_output: >= 90% rated 'supported by cited headline' by the grounding agent (qwen3, a different model from the system's gpt-oss); human spot-check of 20 bullets agrees >= 85%
